data.name: Vat_Explanation_Domestic
data.value: Domestic (PL-PL): You add {0} VAT to the invoice. The client pays it, and you transfer it to the office. It's not your income.

data.name: Vat_Explanation_Foreign
data.value: Foreign (B2B): 0% Rate (Reverse Charge). You don't pay tax on sales, but you typically get a REFUND for VAT paid on purchases.

data.name: Vat_Explanation_Payment
data.value: Payment Rule: You only pay VAT to the office if you received it from the client

data.name: Vat_Explanation_Deduction
data.value: Lump Sum Benefit: On Ryczałt, you can't deduct costs from Income Tax, BUT as a VAT payer you recover {0} of expenses from the Tax Office.
